description.text: Sneak-right-click supported ground with Burnt Twig, Plant Tool Binding, or Very Refined Stone to start the assembly. Build it to 2 Burnt Twigs, 4 Plant Tool Bindings, and 4 Very Refined Stone. The Crude Stone Multitool has 128 durability, 2 total attack damage, cutter attack speed, inherits crude hammer/cutter operations, and performs most of them about 25% faster.
